places.name: The Clubhouse

places.name: New Restaurant
places.description: The new restaurant with a deck over the fields. Staff set its name and hours.

places.name: Home Run Dugout
places.description: Topgolf-style hitting bays: swing for targets, compete with your team.

places.name: Monster Milkshake
places.description: Over-the-top milkshakes piled high with candy, cookies and cake.

places.name: Pro Cards & Jerseys Trailer
places.description: Real baseball cards and jerseys of pro players.

places.name: Custom Apparel
places.description: Custom shirts and hats printed on site with your team name.

places.name: Glossy Finish
places.description: On-site vendor. Staff add the details.

around.name: Country Inn (on site)
around.description: Rooms right at the Village, behind the entrance sign.

around.name: National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum
around.description: The heart of baseball history: plaques, artifacts and exhibits. Plan a few hours.

around.name: Doubleday Field
around.description: The historic ballpark a short walk from the Hall of Fame.

around.name: Main Street Cooperstown
around.description: Baseball card shops, bat makers, souvenirs, ice cream and pizza.

around.name: Otsego Lake
around.description: Boat tours, swimming and sunsets at the north end of Main Street.

around.name: The Farmers’ Museum
around.description: A working 1800s village with a hand-carved carousel.

around.name: Fenimore Art Museum
around.description: American art and folk art on the shore of Otsego Lake.

around.name: Glimmerglass State Park
around.description: Beach, hiking and picnics at the top of the lake.

around.name: Fly Creek Cider Mill
around.description: Fresh cider, fudge and tastings in a historic mill.

around.name: Howe Caverns
around.description: Underground boat ride through limestone caves. A good rain-day trip.

around.name: More lodging coming soon
